'''Colline''' was a [[Da'shain]] [[Aiel]], later [[Jenn Aiel]], who lived during the middle of the [[Breaking of the World]].

==History==
Colline was the sister of [[Charlin]] and [[Alijha]]. Her mother was [[Nerrine]]. She was abducted by bandits, then rescued by a group of Aiel including her brothers. Her brother Charlin was killed during the rescue.{{ref/book|4|25}}

From absence of further details in [[The Wheel of Time Companion]], it is presumed that she did not abandon the [[Way of the Leaf]]. If so, she would have become one of the first generation of those known as the [[Jenn Aiel]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Colline}}
